title: Appliance Repair Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Appliance Repair: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Appliance Repair Completion Report covers household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish. The home appliance service coordinator records Residential Appliance Repair performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Appliance Repair Completion Report keeps Residential Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the home appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Completion Report at residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area. Document household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish identity before Residential Appliance Repair begins. Compare household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish findings with stated Residential Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Residential Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance technician. For Appliance Repair Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance technician to review Residential Appliance Repair conditions beyond the home appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completed-scope context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, residence, room, appliance position, utility connection, and protected work area, and the linked household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish source.

fields.label: Appliance type, make, model, and serial
Symptom, fault code, cycle, load, and prior repair history

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Appliance Repair facts for household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Appliance Repair completion checks
items: Power, gas, water, drain, and vent connection
Door, seal, latch, interlock, and enclosure
Motor, pump, fan, heater, sensor, and control behavior
Leak, drainage, airflow, temperature, and cycle result
Floor, cabinet, wall, and surrounding property condition

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Appliance Repair conditions; have home appliance service coordinator assign the next Residential Appliance Repair owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, water, refrigerant, or combustion concern
Property damage or test condition outside scope
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, part concern, property risk, or unsafe test remains. Retain the available Residential Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved household appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and surrounding finish scope to home appliance service coordinator.
